remediation.reason: Re-review failed: merge commits hide product changes from the implement-window check

findings.summary: Verified fixed for ordinary commits: a hooks-off task commit changing product code after validate yields eval-change-outside-implement. Merge variant tracked as R4.
Verified fixed: hooks-off task commits after close raise eval-commit-after-close; STATE_PATH protected; committed state no longer trusted.
Verified fixed: fullSddCompleted = compliant && closed.has(taskId), matching spec decision 3 and docs.

After validate, a --no-ff merge of a bookkeeping-only side branch that also stages the product change, committed hooks-off with the task trailer, is graded compliant and fullSddCompleted: windowIssues uses git diff-tree -r <hash>, which prints nothing for merge commits. Diff against the first parent or reject merge commits, with a test.

Plain lifecycle, inline hook-verified implement commits and remediation back to implement grade compliant with no issues; smuggling into remediation/validate/reconcile-memory transitions is caught. A remediation false-positive test would lock this in.
A fully forged certification chain with hooks disabled cannot be proven locally; documented in docs/EVALS.md consistent with the README authorship caveat.
